crossRefs.note: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes…
Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you…
When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David…
But you know the proof of him, that as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
“The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother: the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the…
“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.

translations.web: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
translations.bsb: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
translations.kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
translations.asv: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.
